info.title: Web App Template API
info.description: Backend API for the web app template.

get.description: Return the current service status. Useful for uptime checks and readiness probes.

post.description: Create a new account and start a session (sets the encrypted cookie).
Verify credentials and start a session (sets the encrypted cookie).
End the current session by clearing the cookie.

get.description: Return the signed-in user and refresh the session window.

post.description: Register a new user. The password is hashed before storage.

get.description: Return a single user by id.
Return a page of the current user's exercises.

post.description: Create a new exercise owned by the current user.

patch.description: Update an exercise owned by the current user. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

delete.description: Delete an exercise owned by the current user.

get.description: Return the current user's settings, seeding defaults if none exist yet.

patch.description: Update the current user's settings. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

get.description: Return all of the current user's workout templates.

post.description: Create a new workout template owned by the current user.

get.description: Return a single workout template owned by the current user.

patch.description: Update a workout template owned by the current user. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

delete.description: Delete a workout template owned by the current user.

get.description: Return the current user's workout sessions that haven't been completed yet.
Return the current user's workout sessions that have been completed.

get.summary: Get completed sets per muscle group for a calendar week
get.description: Return how many sets were completed per muscle group in a Monday-to-Sunday week.

parameters.name: weeks_ago

schema.description: Which calendar week to look at: 0 is the current week, 1 the last, 10 ten weeks ago.
schema.title: Weeks Ago

parameters.description: Which calendar week to look at: 0 is the current week, 1 the last, 10 ten weeks ago.

get.summary: Get a workout session by ID
get.description: Return a single workout session owned by the current user.

delete.description: Delete a workout session owned by the current user.

patch.description: Update a workout session owned by the current user. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

post.summary: Start a workout session from a template
post.description: Start a new workout session copying the exercises of a template owned by the current user.
Pause an in-progress workout session. Responds with 409 if it is completed or paused.
Resume a paused workout session. Responds with 409 if it isn't paused.

Mark a workout session owned by the current user as completed.

A paused session must be resumed first; otherwise responds with 409.

WorkoutSessionUpdate.title: WorkoutSessionUpdate
WorkoutSessionUpdate.description:
Payload for updating a workout session. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

``template_id`` and ``completed_at`` may be set to ``null`` explicitly to
clear them (e.g. reopening a completed session). When ``exercises`` is
provided, it replaces the entire set of exercise slots and their sets;
``position`` and ``set_number`` are assigned from list order.

exercises.title: Exercises
exercises.description: Exercise slots to add, in order.

WorkoutTemplateUpdate.title: WorkoutTemplateUpdate
WorkoutTemplateUpdate.description:
Payload for updating a workout template. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

When ``exercises`` is provided, it replaces the entire set of slots;
position is assigned from list order, so reordering is done by
resubmitting the list in the desired order.
